summary.name: TikAlyzer
summary.one_liner: TikAlyzer is a paid AI video analysis tool that scores short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts) and gives specific fixes for hooks, pacing, retention, and engagement.
keywords: why tiktok videos don't go viral
use_cases: diagnose why a TikTok video gets skipped in the first seconds
find the exact second viewers drop off a video
improve hooks and pacing before posting
analyze Reels or YouTube Shorts alongside TikTok
review content for a team or agency
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI tool that analyzes uploaded videos or pasted TikTok, Reel, or YouTube Shorts URLs. It checks the hook, pacing, retention drop-off points, and engagement signals, then returns a 0-100 score with example issues and suggested fixes. Examples shown include a viral score, hook quality notes, and retention drop-off timestamps. It is offered as a mobile app and a desktop web version, and it includes a 2-minute analysis. Paid plans are listed at $9.99, $19.99, and $49.99 per month, with features such as drop-off point analysis, export reports, and team collaboration at higher tiers. It also runs an affiliate program offering 30% commission.
notable: Pinpoints the exact second viewers drop off, with specific fixes
Analyzes TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts links or uploads
Affiliate program offering 30% commission on subscriptions
caveats: Subscription required: plans listed from $9.99/month to $49.99/month
Results figures such as 300% view increases and 'expected' view jumps are marketing claims on the page, not independently verified
Platform list names a mobile app and web version; the page does not specify Android explicitly
